reason: Static implementation review found four contract-clarity defects before the parent-order price workflow existed or any price label, model metric, action or PnL was produced.

corrections.surface: market price and contextual flow series
corrections.before: The draft parser built the market path only from non-liquidation crossed fills.
corrections.after: Build the market price path from every valid target-coin fill and deduplicate by trade id; use every valid crossed fill for causal taker-flow context; restrict parent-child detection itself to crossed non-liquidation fills.
corrections.scientific_reason: The target/stop path must not omit real prints merely because the print is a maker-side duplicate or liquidation. Wallet parent-order identity remains protected from liquidation contamination.

corrections.before: The draft used price weighted by quote notional, which double-weighted price.
corrections.after: Collapse one child OID at size-weighted VWAP while retaining summed quote notional as a separate feature.

corrections.before: The draft allowed a new entry at the exact prior exit timestamp and calculated sample-day growth only across dates containing authorized actions.
corrections.after: Require new entry time strictly after the previous exit, and include every fixed confirmation or validation date in geometric sample-day growth with zero-return no-trade dates.
corrections.scientific_reason: This prevents same-timestamp order-of-events optimism and aligns growth with the frozen sample calendar.

corrections.before: The draft silently reused the 150-row confirmation minimum in conditional validation.
corrections.after: Retain 150 resolved confirmation rows and use a separately explicit 60 resolved-row validation minimum; both partitions require both classes.
corrections.scientific_reason: No hidden gate may be stricter than the written validation contract.
